About BeMama

Your Privacy and Data Safety on BeMama

Updated: July 1, 2026

This article is shown in English while its translation is prepared.

The information you share on a motherhood journey — cycles, pregnancies, symptoms, your child’s details — is among the most personal data there is. This page explains, in plain language, how BeMama approaches that responsibility. The full privacy policy on the website is always the complete and authoritative version.

Sensitive data, treated with care

BeMama is designed around the understanding that planning, pregnancy, fertility, baby, child, and wellbeing information is sensitive. That understanding shapes how the app is built and how your information is handled.

The guiding principle is simple: your information exists to serve you inside the app, not to be scattered around. We aim to describe our practices honestly and in plain language rather than burying them in legal fog.

What your data is actually used for

Your information is used to provide the features you ask for: personalizing your Daily Journey to your stage, remembering what you track, running your account, and making Q&A and community spaces work.

It is also used for safety and moderation — for example, reviewing reported content to keep community spaces safe — and for practical operations like troubleshooting problems and responding to your support or privacy requests.

You can request deletion or export

BeMama provides paths to request deletion of your data and to request an export of it. If you decide to leave, or simply want a copy of your information, those routes exist and are described in the privacy policy.

Requests can be sent through the support channels listed on the website, and the privacy policy explains what to expect from the process.

Your choices in everyday use

You control a lot day to day: what you choose to enter, what you post publicly versus keep to yourself, and which device permissions — like notifications, camera, or microphone — you allow. Permissions are requested only for features that need them.

A good habit anywhere on the internet applies here too: keep urgent medical details and other people’s private information out of public community posts.

Read the full policy — really

This page is a friendly summary, not the fine print. The full privacy policy on the BeMama website describes what is collected, how it is used and shared, retention basics, and your request paths in detail — and it controls if anything here differs.

We wrote it to be readable. If something in it is unclear, you can ask through the support channels on the site, and we would genuinely rather answer the question than leave you unsure.

Key takeaways

  • Motherhood data is sensitive, and BeMama is designed around that responsibility.
  • Your data is used to personalize your journey, run features, and support safety and moderation.
  • Deletion and export request paths exist and are described in the privacy policy.
  • You control what you share, what you post publicly, and which device permissions you grant.
  • The full privacy policy on the website is the complete, authoritative version.

Frequently asked questions

What is my data used for?

Mainly to provide what you ask for — personalizing your Daily Journey, powering tools and community features, and running your account — plus safety, moderation, and troubleshooting. The privacy policy has the full detail.

Can I delete my data or get a copy of it?

Yes. BeMama provides paths to request deletion and export of your data. The privacy policy and the support channels on the website explain how to make these requests.

Where do I find the complete privacy details?

On the privacy policy page of the BeMama website. It is written in plain language and is the authoritative description of BeMama’s data practices.

This article is general education, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always talk with a qualified healthcare professional about your situation, and seek urgent care for emergencies.
